title: Regenerate an identity provider SCIM token (prepare)
description: Step 1 of 2 for regenerate SCIM bearer token. Validates the arguments and returns a signed confirmation_hash plus a message to surface to the user. The user must reply with the literal word "confirm" before you call the matching -execute tool with the hash. Original action: Regenerate the SCIM bearer token for an identity provider configuration. The new token is returned once; existing SCIM clients stop working until configured with the new token. This call requires explicit user confirmation.
